purpose: Select a shared reward-blind warm start after making the SFT renderer token-identical to the frozen Stage C3 live policy contexts.

v2_terminal_record.accepted_disposition: V2 remains terminal and is never resumed or retried.
v2_terminal_record.v3_legitimacy: V2 evaluated a different conditional distribution from the one its SFT objective optimized. V3 is a distinct corrected selection with fresh optimizer randomness, not a threshold-informed retry.

renderer_defect.fix: Use the exact Prime-Qwen3 campaign renderer in SFT and require all 40 prompt/target token pairs to match the frozen live scorer before optimization.

factorized_dataset.policy: Reuse the byte-identical reward-blind factorized corpus. The defect was its renderer, not its labels or factorization.

initialization.selection_training_model: Merge the inherited adapter into the named base in BF16, then train one new LoRA against that exact deployed initialization.

sft.unchanged_from_v2: Corpus, batch shape, optimizer, learning rate, scheduler, LoRA shape, step count, checkpoint cadence, and no-shuffle policy.
sft.one_run_rule: After the first optimizer step, do not rerun SFT, change the corpus, change hyperparameters, or train replacement candidates.

candidate_selection.rule: Select the earliest ascending optimizer checkpoint satisfying every frozen check; later checkpoints are not consulted.
candidate_selection.no_passing_candidate: Record a terminal Stage C4 selection failure, run no RL campaign, recover compact artifacts, and do not retry this selection.

authoritative_scoring.model_form: BF16 merged model, never runtime-LoRA scores
authoritative_scoring.engine: Pinned vLLM installation and the campaign model-loading mode
authoritative_scoring.parallelization: Action and root scorers are independent and run concurrently on separate GPUs; their signed payloads and decision logic are unchanged.

separation.campaign_freeze_condition: A selected adapter hash, merged-model manifest, exact support report, and terminal selection record must be local before any credit-confusion RL call.

renderer_alignment_gate.position: after inherited-model merge and before the first v3 SFT optimizer step
renderer_alignment_gate.failure_handling: Any mismatch terminally closes v3 before optimization.

scorer_lifecycle.implementation: The unchanged signed hard-exit supervisor validated in v2.
scorer_lifecycle.v2_live_evidence: 2 lifecycle scorers plus 32 candidate scorers exited zero with parent-verified signatures.
scorer_lifecycle.v3_policy: Every candidate scorer still uses the signed supervisor; no redundant pre-SFT model-scoring gate is run.

pre_model_call_checks: Verify every frozen source and data hash.
Run all root tests and affected Prime/taskset tests.
Parse the SFT configuration through Prime-RL SFTConfig.
Verify the expected external Prime patch reverse-applies.
Run the frozen v3 preregistration audit.
execution.failure_handling: After any optimizer step, any failure is terminal for v3. Recover all compact artifacts and do not retry.
execution.local_artifact_policy: Keep exact scores, signed verifications, manifests, logs, reports, and only a selected adapter. Do not sync intermediate adapters, merged 4B models, optimizer states, or CUDA caches.
execution.remote_cleanup: Remove every rejected merged candidate before scoring the next and destroy all unretained checkpoints at teardown.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

hardware.availability_observed: 2026-07-29: resource 0eabc6 reported Low stock at $0.8968/hour; non-spot 2x RTX 6000 Ada and 2x L40S were Available at $1.50 and $1.64/hour.
hardware.selection_reason: A40 is eligible, BF16-capable, under the $2/hour ceiling, and the cheapest observed non-spot 2x48GB resource.
hardware.fallback_rule: Do not silently substitute hardware. If resource 0eabc6 cannot be provisioned before any model call, commit a hardware-only amendment and repeat the source audit.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without model calls if it fails.
